game_concept: A logic puzzle set in The Kingdom – Dungeon Stairs, the castle dungeon stairwell: the baker's apprentice must handle goblin raiders while practicing variables & assignment. Core idea – Reassign Relay: Overwrite a variable with a fresh value each round so the old number vanishes before goblin raiders can use it.
theme: The Kingdom – Dungeon Stairs: the castle dungeon stairwell
core_gameplay_loop: In Dungeon Stairs, repeat each round: Overwrite a variable with a fresh value each round so the old number vanishes before goblin raiders can use it. Each round costs one action, so plan the step so none are wasted. Then check the wave_target value and advance.
secondary_mechanics: Hint tokens that reveal one line of code
player_objective: Reach the signal beacon using at most 16 actions, so every code step counts.
controls: Keyboard: arrow keys move the hero, SPACE performs the main action, ENTER runs the code.
win_condition: The signal beacon reached with actions_used <= 16.
lose_condition: actions_used exceeds 16 before the signal beacon is reached, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 1 – Variables & Assignment | Level 5 (applied tier): Reassign Relay
assets_style: storybook pixel-art kingdom: green meadows, red-roofed towers, royal blue and gold trim; flat Kenney-style sprites; bright medieval lute and fanfare with market chatter

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how wave_target changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against goblin raiders in Dungeon Stairs.
